closure.image_extent_rule: Actual SETTIMG source size code 2, width 1; LOADBLOCK consumes (lrs+1)*2 bytes. LOADTLUT consumes (count+1)*2 bytes. installation.layout: Exactly caller-owned 8 MiB, word-swapped canonical backend RAM. dst[(guest - 0x80000000 + i) XOR 3] = source[i].
installation.span_rule: Sorted union of reachable list, vertex-load and image-load byte extents; merge only overlapping or immediately adjacent selected spans. No full bank copies or alignment padding.
installation.prewrite_rejections: Wrong RAM extent, moved-from Snapshot, RAM/ROM alias, invalid additional reservation extent, any selected resource overlap with built-in/additional reservations, invalid target/source provenance. All targets checked before any write; all other bytes preserved, including partial palette words.
installation.metadata_policy: GAME setup/descriptor/table/fixed-GFX/sky wires are retained as native borrowed metadata only, never installed as misleading guest pointers to excluded runtime resources. No per-frame resource allocation.

explicit_exclusions.note: These numeric references are retained, not dereferenced/installed. Excludes roads, movement/camera evaluation, attached static objects, actors/spawns, other primary and secondary block geometry, dynamic materials/animations and full scene orchestration. Genuine first static terrain and sky wrappers ARE implemented by StartProducer. No synthetic material list, fake scene callback or terminator is substituted.
